snippet.title: Seven Blasphemies - ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
Seven Blasphemies is a traditional turn-based roguelike where every dawn may curse your run forever.

Explore a dying world, choose from doomed classes, and survive lethal OSR-inspired encounters. Every dawn, a new Blasphemy may strike: a permanent curse that stacks with everything that came before it. Visibility shrinks. Healing weakens. Monsters grow bolder. When the seventh Blasphemy arrives, the world ends.

You are not racing toward glory. You are racing against extinction.

▶ Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4893400/Seven_Blasphemies/

FEATURES
• Traditional turn-based roguelike gameplay
• Grid-based movement and tactical positioning
• Permadeath and high-stakes decision-making
• A doom calendar that pressures every run
• 7 permanent Blasphemies that alter the world
• 6 playable classes with distinct playstyles
• Minimalist pixel art with a harsh, apocalyptic tone
• OSR-inspired design focused on scarcity, risk, and consequence

Follow development:
Discord: https://discord.gg/gpmueNSSQU
Twitter/X: https://x.com/Crit42Studio
Website: https://crit42.com/

#roguelike #indiegame #turnbased #pixelart #OSR
